_purpose: Owner risk-approval record consumed by app/scripts/preflight.py (approval_exists gate). Its presence lets TRADING READY go green ONLY if every BLOCK-level config check also passes. It documents the specific limits the owner approved; it does not itself weaken any check.
authorization: Owner explicitly approved these candidate thresholds/limits and authorized a bounded ALPACA PAPER restart to observe live behavior. No live-money trading is approved.

strategy_parameters.note: Thresholds are the labeled CANDIDATE defaults; owner approves them for PAPER evaluation only. Source '65.92% CAGR' claim is NOT reproduced and is NOT accepted as fact.

position_sizing.acknowledged_risk: stake_amount='unlimited' means one all-in spot position on the paper account (~full equity). Approved for paper observation; MUST be bounded before any live consideration.
position_sizing.preflight_warn: UNLIMITED_STAKE remains a WARN by design (documented approval), not a BLOCK.

guardrails: Spot only, long-only, unleveraged; no borrowing, no margin, no shorts.
AI/research layer may annotate only; it must never change these approved rules or place orders.
Reconciliation (app/scripts/reconcile.py) runs on a cadence; any CRITICAL/OFFLINE/STALE status stops promotion.
No promotion to real money without a separate explicit owner approval and a clean multi-week paper reconciliation.
